page: Microsoft Azure E8-2ds_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the EDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 1 physical core and 2 vCPUs operating at 2.8 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32.0 GB per core. It is equipped with a 307 GB local SSD storage volume, but does not include any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average category. However, multi-core performance is limited due to the 2-vCPU constraint, resulting in poor ratings for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached read and write speeds for large blocks rated as poor, though the Passmark memory score remains average.

Given the high memory density relative to compute resources, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that demand large memory footprints but low CPU utilization. The bundled 307 GB local SSD provides fast local storage, making it suitable for relational databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing tasks that do not require heavy parallel computation. It is less suitable for multi-threaded compilation, ray tracing, or high-throughput web serving.
